verdict.rationale: ImageMagick ships configurable security policies (Open, Limited, Secure, Websafe as of 7.1.1-16). Community reports confirm policy.xml can disable script-like coders such as MSL, MVG, URL and EPHEMERAL. That protection is opt-in, though: the ImageTragick RCE came from a delegate executing a user-controlled system/wget call, and SVG/MVG input is still parsed by interpreter-like logic unless the operator locks it down. missing for 10: safe-by-default handling of script/macro formats, first-party documentation of what each policy blocks, and independent evidence that the hardened policies prevent execution.
